spec.description:
vmsync disk-replication metrics, from -prometheus-textfile. See pkg/nbdbridge/README.md and pkg/metrics for how these are produced.

Written by Orsiris de Jong <ozy@netpower.fr>

spec.title: Last sync state
spec.description: 0 = success, 1 = failure -- one value per VM, reflecting the whole run (not any single disk). See vmsync_sync_state.

spec.title: Throughput per disk
spec.description: vmsync_transferred_bytes / vmsync_sync_duration_seconds -- average logical throughput for that disk's sync (not a live/instantaneous rate, since both inputs are per-run gauges).

spec.title: Throughput per VM
spec.description: sum(vmsync_transferred_bytes) by (vm) / max(vmsync_sync_duration_seconds) by (vm) -- total bytes moved across the VM's (selected) disks, divided by the longest-running disk's duration. Uses max, not sum, because vmsync syncs a VM's disks concurrently, not sequentially -- summing durations would understate this VM's actual aggregate throughput.

spec.title: Stale VMs (no completed run in 24h)
spec.description: count(time() - vmsync_last_run_timestamp_seconds > 86400). Detects a stale/stopped textfile -- a VM whose vmsync cron/timer hasn't completed a run recently, success or failure. Adjust the 86400 (24h) threshold in this panel's query to match your actual sync schedule.

spec.title: Time since last completed run, per VM
spec.description: time() - vmsync_last_run_timestamp_seconds. Age of each VM's most recent finished sync (success or failure), for spotting a stale/stuck vmsync job before it turns into a missed-RPO surprise. The 6h/24h threshold colors below are placeholders -- adjust to your actual sync cadence.

spec.title: Quiescing failed
spec.description: VMs whose most recent sync succeed but quiescing failed.

spec.title: Verification failures
spec.description: VMs whose most recent verifications failed

spec.title: Currently Okay
spec.description: VMs whose most recent sync succeed

spec.title: VMs monitored
spec.description: Distinct VMs that have reported at least one sync.

spec.title: Verification success
spec.description: VMs whose most recent verifications succeed

spec.title: Currently failing
spec.description: VMs whose most recent sync ended in failure.

spec.title: Compression ratio (last sync)
spec.description: 1 - (compressed wire bytes / logical transferred bytes), summed across selected VMs/disks. 0% when --compress/--netbuffer aren't used (wire bytes == logical bytes).

spec.title: Disks
spec.description: One row per disk, from the most recent sync of each VM.

spec.title: Sync duration
spec.description: One step per completed sync -- these are gauges, not counters, so each point is that run's total duration, not a rate.

spec.title: Transferred vs. compressed-transferred bytes
spec.description: Logical bytes copied vs. actual bytes sent over the network for that disk's sync. Identical lines when --compress/--netbuffer are unused.

spec.title: vmsync
